title: Error creating macro trying to create a base table with fields already aliased
answer:
I don't really follow what the rest of your macro is doing, but to answer your question, you can generate a list of Relation objects by using dbt_utils, specifically the get_relations_by_pattern macro:

{% set relations = dbt_utils.get_relations_by_pattern(schema_name, '%') %}
{% set tables = relations | selectattr("type", "equalto", "table") %}
